metadata.count_rule: fixed: complete requests until each lane reaches horizon + 2 longest-request compute times; varying order: equal integer cycle counts across lanes and order treatments
metadata.load_caveat: sum per-lane total bytes / total ideal compute is a necessary long-run capacity check, not a sufficient per-layer deadline proof. Mixed-order finite averages can conceal bursts.
metadata.sampling_caveat: Constructed saturated finite backlog; all requests arrive at t=0. No external byte-rate claim.
metadata.scale_caveat: target_rho only increases all compute times. Request counts are recomputed to retain the ideal-compute horizon, so scaled and unscaled populations may differ; strategies within a frozen manifest use identical requests.
